title: Stuffed Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 tablespoons grated American or cheddar cheese
steps: Cut a thin slice off the top of each tomato. Scoop out pulp, leaving a 1/2-in. shell. Invert onto paper towels to drain. Mix stuffing ingredients. Spoon into tomatoes.
Place tomatoes on a baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Last few minutes, broil until crusty brown. Keep a close eye on them, don't over do it…
